note: Every gap has one PRIMARY category (A missing-implementation / B missing-wiring / C contract-mismatch / D test-only-illusion), secondary tags, severity, and repair priority. Read-only audit; nothing repaired here.

gaps.title: Section 3 innate immune runtime does not exist
gaps.evidence: No innate biology module (macrophage/NK/DC/antigen-presentation/innate-integration runtime). innate-immunity + antigen-presentation registries are structure-only.
gaps.note: Section 4 was explicitly built to consume innate via an availability-gated contract; absence yields UNAVAILABLE (never zero). Repairing this is Section 3 scope, not Part 2 of this section.

gaps.title: Section-4 runtimes compute states but never emit transition records
gaps.evidence: Transition truth test: 4 CD8-priming states crossed over 8 production frames -> 0 transition records. immuneAdaptiveEngine passes no transitionRecords; runtimes use categorize() not ImmuneStateController.
gaps.note: ImmuneStateController + TransitionRecord + immune-transition registry (26 machines) all exist and are correct; only the wiring from the Section-4 runtimes to the controllers + into buildImmuneFrame is missing.

gaps.title: Two engines feed the canonical builder divergent nested domain-state shapes
gaps.evidence: immuneEscape: S1 {components,escapePressure,persistentEscape} vs S4 {dimensions,magnitudeState,overallEscapePressure,persistenceState}. adaptiveImmunity.cd8: S1 CD8State(metric slots) vs S4 CD8Contribution. Same top-level 32 keys, divergent nested shapes.
gaps.note: Renderer masks divergence via a spec table with fallbacks. Canonical builder migration should converge the domain-state contract (single authoritative shape) OR formalize a versioned domain-state adapter.

gaps.title: Two divergent input-normalization paths
gaps.evidence: S1 engine uses ImmuneInputAdapter; S4 engine uses buildAdaptiveContext (reads 7A/7B engines directly). Different field names/normalization.
gaps.note: Not fatal; both are read-only and availability-aware. Convergence reduces drift.

gaps.title: Section-2 transition-controller + evidence/prediction lifecycle frameworks unused in production
gaps.evidence: ImmuneStateController, immuneEvidencePrediction (ImmunePredictionRecord/makePrediction) not imported by any src engine. Frames carry STATIC registry-reference records only.
gaps.note: Predictions/evidence resolve against registries (valid) but have no runtime lifecycle (created/confirmed/invalidated).

gaps.title: End-to-end tests inject a synthetic innateContribution (no real Section 3)
gaps.evidence: immuneAdaptive.test.mjs + immuneRender.test.mjs build innate={readiness:A(..),...} by hand and pass it in. Production Section-3 module does not exist.
gaps.note: Adaptive engine + frame builder + renderer paths ARE production; only the innate INPUT is synthetic. Flagged so fixture success is not read as real innate end-to-end validation.

gaps.title: Renderer transition-view test injects a synthetic transition record
gaps.evidence: immuneRender.test.mjs `withT` hand-builds a transitionRecords entry to exercise buildTransitionView; the same test also asserts production frames have 0 transition records.
gaps.note: Honest + explicitly flagged in the test; not masking. Becomes real once G2 is repaired.

gaps.title: Adaptive context does not use the shared ImmuneInputAdapter for upstream reads
gaps.evidence: buildAdaptiveContext reads vascular/micro engines directly rather than via ImmuneInputAdapter (which the S1 engine uses).

no_illusion_confirmations: No test hand-builds a final frame bypassing buildImmuneFrame (all use engine.evaluate().frame).
No test uses zero where production requires unavailable (UNAVAILABLE metrics carry value:null).
No test validates Phase 8A with mocked immune values (8A adapter reads real engine readiness).
No test deep-freezes objects production leaves mutable (buildImmuneFrame deep-freezes in production).
